AgesSettings.description:
Ages (docs/AGES_DESIGN.md): each player advances on their own, paying (always
with fish) and waiting a research time, for points and bonuses.

fish_ransom_age.description: With ages on, ``robber.fish_ransom`` only protects players in this age or later.
fish_ransom_age.label: settings.ages.fish_ransom_age
fish_ransom_age.title: Fish Ransom Age

settler_gather_age.description: With ages on, settlers only gather (``settlers.gather``) for players in this age or later.
settler_gather_age.label: settings.ages.settler_gather_age
settler_gather_age.title: Settler Gather Age

settler_guard_age.description:
With ages on, settlers only keep the robber away (``settlers.block_robber``) for players
in this age or later.
settler_guard_age.label: settings.ages.settler_guard_age
settler_guard_age.title: Settler Guard Age

unlock.description: The age each construction needs (missing kinds: age I).
unlock.label: settings.ages.unlock
unlock.title: Unlock

AgesSettings.title: AgesSettings

per_resource.description: Cards per resource. Input may be a single int applied to every resource.
per_resource.label: settings.economy.bank.per_resource
per_resource.title: Per Resource

number_tokens.description: token -> count. None = auto; explicit total must equal producing land hexes.
number_tokens.label: settings.board.number_tokens
number_tokens.title: Number Tokens

robber_start.description: ``desert``: a random desert; on a board without deserts, a random land hex.
robber_start.label: settings.board.robber_start

sea_margin.description: Rings of sea drawn around the island.
sea_margin.label: settings.board.sea_margin
sea_margin.title: Sea Margin

seed.description: Board seed for ``layout=seeded``. None = derived from the game seed.
seed.label: settings.board.seed
seed.title: Seed

terrain_counts.description: None = auto (see ``resolve``); explicit counts must sum to ``land_hexes`` (missing = 0).
terrain_counts.label: settings.board.terrain_counts
terrain_counts.title: Terrain Counts

city.description: Total points of a city (it replaces the settlement's points).
city.label: settings.victory.building_points.city
city.title: City

megacity.description: Total points of a megacity (it replaces the city's points).
megacity.label: settings.victory.building_points.megacity
megacity.title: Megacity

refill.description: A fresh copy of ``deck`` is shuffled in when it runs out, so cards never run out.
refill.label: settings.dev_cards.refill
refill.title: Refill

vp_cards_must_be_played.description: Off: a victory point card counts as soon as it is bought (and is never played).
vp_cards_must_be_played.label: settings.dev_cards.vp_cards_must_be_played
vp_cards_must_be_played.title: Vp Cards Must Be Played

count.description: None = auto (6 at 19 land hexes, scaled).
count.label: settings.board.fishing_grounds.count
count.title: Count

min_gap.description: Minimum number of hexes between two fishing grounds.
min_gap.label: settings.board.fishing_grounds.min_gap
min_gap.title: Min Gap

tokens.description: Token values, cycled in order when the count differs from their number.
tokens.label: settings.board.fishing_grounds.tokens
tokens.title: Tokens

generic.description: Generic (3:1) harbors. None = auto (4 at 19 land hexes, scaled).
generic.label: settings.board.harbors.generic
generic.title: Generic

specific.description: Resource-specific (2:1) harbors per resource; never auto-scaled; missing = 0.
specific.label: settings.board.harbors.specific
specific.title: Specific

min.description: Minimum knights played to claim the award.
min.label: settings.victory.largest_army.min
min.title: Min

LargestPopulationSettings.description: With ages on: an award, like the Longest Road, for the largest population.

min.description: Population needed to claim the award.
min.label: settings.ages.largest_population.min
min.title: Min

LargestPopulationSettings.title: LargestPopulationSettings

min.description: Minimum road length (segments) to claim the award.
min.label: settings.victory.longest_road.min
min.title: Min

megacities.description: Megacities upgrade an own city (the city piece returns). 0 disables them.
megacities.label: settings.pieces.megacities
megacities.title: Megacities

min_land_per_player.description: Games with more than ``sized_for`` players need this many land hexes per player.
min_land_per_player.label: settings.players.min_land_per_player
min_land_per_player.title: Min Land Per Player

scale_for_more.description: Bigger games scale the island and bank up (see ``settings.scaling``).
scale_for_more.label: settings.players.scale_for_more
scale_for_more.title: Scale For More

sized_for.description: Player count the board size and bank are written for.
sized_for.label: settings.players.sized_for
sized_for.title: Sized For

fish_ransom.description:
On a seven, a target holding at least this many fish loses exactly that many fish
instead of the usual steal (0 = off). Meant for the Age of the Sea.
fish_ransom.label: settings.robber.fish_ransom
fish_ransom.title: Fish Ransom

spare_setup.description: Players still building their setup settlements and roads are never robbed (sevens, knights or monopoly).
spare_setup.label: settings.robber.spare_setup
spare_setup.title: Spare Setup

spare_setup_ms.description:
How long ``spare_setup`` lasts, from the start of the game (None = until the player finishes
their setup). Afterwards a player who never finished their setup is robbed like anyone else,
so an absent player cannot hoard the bank's cards forever.
spare_setup_ms.label: settings.robber.spare_setup_ms
spare_setup_ms.title: Spare Setup Ms

block_robber.description: The robber cannot move onto a hex with a settler on one of its corners.
block_robber.label: settings.settlers.block_robber
block_robber.title: Block Robber

gather.description: A settler at rest gathers from the hexes around it when one of its numbers is rolled.
gather.label: settings.settlers.gather
gather.title: Gather

gather_rolls.description: Numbers of the 1st, 2nd, 3rd... settler of a player (repeating).
gather_rolls.label: settings.settlers.gather_rolls
gather_rolls.title: Gather Rolls

max.description: Hard cap of settlers per player (on top of the per-building allowance).
max.label: settings.settlers.max
max.title: Max

per_city.description:
Settlers a player may have: per_settlement per settlement plus per_city per city
(megacities count as cities), at least 1, at most ``max``. Both 0: just ``max``.
per_city.label: settings.settlers.per_city
per_city.title: Per City

road_speed_pct.description: Walking speed on the player's own roads, in percent of normal speed.
road_speed_pct.label: settings.settlers.road_speed_pct
road_speed_pct.title: Road Speed Pct

network_build_during_setup.description: False: a player builds on the network only after finishing their own setup.
network_build_during_setup.label: settings.setup.network_build_during_setup
network_build_during_setup.title: Network Build During Setup

granting_settlements.description: How many of a player's first settlements grant starting resources.
granting_settlements.label: settings.economy.starting_resources.granting_settlements
granting_settlements.title: Granting Settlements

description: All per-game settings. Validate raw input with ``parse_settings`` (runs migrations).
title: GameSettings
